religion.pick: Which faith treats {label} as a sacred text?

religion.odd: Three of these are sacred texts of {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Ramayana
rows.description: An ancient Hindu epic composed by Valmiki which narrates the life story of Lord Rama.
rows.hook: tells of a prince's exile, his kidnapped wife, and a rescue aided by an army of monkey warriors

rows.label: Qur’an
rows.description: foundational Islamic religious text
rows.hook: is divided into 114 chapters and is revered as a direct revelation to the Prophet Muhammad

rows.label: Bhagavad Gita
rows.description: primary holy scripture for Hinduism
rows.hook: records a battlefield conversation between the warrior Arjuna and his charioteer Krishna

rows.label: Bible
rows.description: collection of sacred books in Judaism and Christianity
rows.hook: is the best-selling book of all time, a library of ancient scriptures in two main parts

rows.label: Mahabharata
rows.description: ancient Sanskrit epic by Vyasa
rows.hook: is one of the longest epic poems ever written, built around a great war between two families of cousins

rows.label: Book of Revelation
rows.description: final book of the New Testament
rows.hook: closes the Bible with visions of seven-headed beasts, horsemen and the end of the world

rows.label: Talmud
rows.description: central text of Rabbinic Judaism
rows.hook: gathers centuries of rabbis' debates and commentary on law, ethics and daily life

rows.label: Torah
rows.description: first five books of the Hebrew Bible
rows.hook: holds the five books from Genesis to Deuteronomy, traditionally credited to Moses

rows.label: Vedas
rows.description: ancient sacred scriptures revealed in Sanskrit to Richi sages and on which Brahmanism, Hinduism, Buddhism and Jainism were based
rows.hook: are the oldest scriptures of ancient India, made up of four great collections

rows.label: Old Testament
rows.description: first division of the Christian biblical canon
rows.hook: is the part of the Bible that opens with Genesis and tells of Adam, Noah and Moses

rows.label: New Testament
rows.description: second division of the Christian biblical canon
rows.hook: is the part of the Bible with four gospels about the life of Jesus and letters from Paul

rows.label: Tao Te Ching
rows.description: Chinese classic text
rows.hook: is a short ancient book of poetic verses on living in harmony with the Way, credited to Laozi

rows.label: Book of Mormon
rows.description: sacred text of the Latter Day Saint movement
rows.hook: is said to be translated from golden plates by its founding prophet Joseph Smith

rows.label: Rigveda
rows.description: most ancient Veda of the Hindus
rows.hook: is a collection of ancient Sanskrit hymns praising gods such as Agni and Indra

rows.label: Upanishads
rows.description: ancient Sanskrit religious and philosophical texts of Hinduism
rows.hook: are ancient Sanskrit texts exploring meditation, consciousness and the nature of the self

rows.label: Guru Granth Sahib
rows.description: The primary holy scripture of Sikhism
rows.hook: is revered as the final eternal guide and is kept in houses of worship called gurdwaras

rows.label: hadith
rows.description: collections of sayings and teachings of Muhammad (and Ahl al-Bayt for Shia Muslims)
rows.hook: records the sayings and actions of the Prophet Muhammad, gathered by scholars like Bukhari

rows.label: Lotus Sutra
rows.description: Mahayana sutra
rows.hook: uses parables such as a burning house to teach that everyone can reach enlightenment

rows.label: Mishnah
rows.description: first major written collection of the Oral Torah
rows.hook: set down oral law in six orders, compiled by Judah the Prince

rows.label: Purana
rows.description: Hindu scriptures
rows.hook: are vast collections of ancient legends about gods, creation and the history of the world
